o.norm: Tests that {@link ByteOrderMark#getCharsetName()} can be loaded as a {@link java.nio.charset.Charset} as advertised.

i.norm: Tests that the charset name advertised by each predefined {@link ByteOrderMark} constant is a real charset that can be resolved via {@link Charset#forName(String)}.
Verifies that {@link ByteOrderMark#getCharsetName()} returns a name that {@link Charset#forName(String)} can load for every predefined BOM constant.
Asserts that the BOM's charset name can be resolved to a {@link Charset}. @param bom the BOM whose advertised charset name should be loadable.
